_note: GLOBAL SEMANTICS for P5B. Scenario-independent: no scenario IDs appear in any rule. Version 1, frozen before holdouts (hash recorded in P5B report).

R-ABSORB-TERMINAL.text: If current read is stand-aside, every branch effect collapses to stand-aside: a broken thesis is not resurrected by any single positioning finding.

R-NO-EVIDENCE.text: Missing data is never evidence: a question with no fresh capable family is unrunnable, not answered.

R-SETUP-BEFORE-OVERLAY.text: On exact ties, direct spot evidence outranks positioning overlay. Tiebreak only; reversals prove non-fixedness.
